description: A valuable manuscript is stolen from the museum's archives during a charity gala.
The thief receives a lucrative offer from a rival collector to steal the manuscript and use it as leverage in a high-stakes negotiation.
The rival collector intends to use the manuscript to force the museum to relinquish ownership of a complementary artifact, completing a rare collection.
The mysterious figure hacks into the collector's financial records to verify the payment for the manuscript's theft
The team of thieves demands additional payment from the mysterious figure after discovering the manuscript's true value
The museum archivist discovers the theft and reports it to the police, who begin an investigation.
The detective discovers a decades-old cold case file with a similar modus operandi to the current theft.
goals: connect the theft to the cold case

description: The detective interviews the museum archivist and learns about a former employee who was obsessed with the stolen manuscript.
The detective investigates the former employee, who has a solid alibi for the night of the theft, but seems nervous and evasive.
goals: clear or implicate the former employee

description: The detective discovers a hidden journal belonging to the former employee, containing cryptic notes about the manuscript and the cold case.
The former employee's cryptic notes in the hidden journal reveal a connection to the mysterious figure, who had been planning the heist for years
The mysterious figure, seeking revenge, manipulates the former employee into providing crucial information about the manuscript's location and security
The detective learns that the former employee had a secret relationship with a wealthy collector, who has a history of using underhanded methods to acquire rare items.
The detective obtains a search warrant for the collector's estate and finds a hidden room containing the stolen manuscript and other rare, stolen items.
The collector reveals that the theft was orchestrated by a mysterious figure from the collector's past, who used the manuscript to settle an old score.
goals: uncover the true motive behind the theft

description: The detective discovers that the mysterious figure is a former accomplice of the cold case victim, seeking revenge for a past betrayal.
goals: bring the mysterious figure to justice

description: The former accomplice seeks revenge against the collector for testifying against them in the cold case
The former accomplice uses the stolen manuscript to blackmail the collector, forcing them to reveal their involvement in the cold case
The detective uncovers evidence of a money trail leading from the collector to an offshore account linked to the mysterious figure
The mysterious figure is revealed to have hired a team of skilled thieves to execute the heist in exchange for a share of the manuscript's value
